prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that on June 14th you were observed using the metric system. Respond to the committee.
response:
**Mr. Chairman, members of the Committee:**

I appear before you today to state, under oath and without reservation, that these allegations are **baseless, un-American, and frankly ridiculous**.

On the night in question, I was engaged in the time-honored, God-fearing, freedom-loving practice of **grilling hamburgers and hot dogs by the generous light of freedom**—using nothing but pounds, inches, Fahrenheit, and good old-fashioned charcoal, just as our Founding Fathers intended.

I have never, **at any time**, used the metric system. I do not traffic in liters. I do not cavort with kilograms. I have certainly never consorted with millimeters in any way that could be considered suspicious. When I want 12 ounces of beer, I ask for **twelve ounces of beer**, not some suspicious "355 milliliters" like some kind of European sleeper agent.

Furthermore, I would like to point out that the only "system" I was using that night was the **Constitutional system** of measuring how many burgers I could fit on the grill while maintaining proper liberty-to-bun ratios.

In conclusion, I am a proud user of **feet, miles, gallons, and degrees that actually make sense**. I denounce the metric system as a foreign plot designed to confuse honest Americans, and I stand ready to name names if the Committee so desires.

Thank you. I yield back the balance of my freedom fries.
